title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The programme is implemented in all 10 regions of Cameroon, targeting girls and boys with disabilities to access mainstream public schools. Partners include the Ministry of Basic Education and Secondary Education, regional delegations of the Ministry of Social Affairs, and Organisations of Persons with Disabilities (OPDs). The aim is to strengthen the education system in 70 government primary schools that include children with disabilities, addressing gendered needs and improving access and quality of education for children with disabilities. Key activities include establishing a national inclusive education policy, scaling up quality inclusive education, and integrating an inclusive education module into teacher training curricula. The overall aim of the project is to ensure that children with disabilities receive quality inclusive education. The project aims to ensure that equal numbers of boys and girls are enrolled.
